welcome.title: Understand your home energy.
welcome.body: Production, consumption and estimates in one place. Deye Cloud supplies station data; Home Assistant adds context only if you choose it.
auth.terms: I accept the terms and privacy policy.
auth.analytics: Allow product analytics without personal data (optional).
auth.note: Your EMS web account also works on mobile. Demo form; do not enter real credentials.
deye.body: EMS imports energy data through its backend. Connecting does not let the app control your inverter.
deye.consent: Allow importing my station data from Deye Cloud.
deye.note: Deye credentials are managed by the backend. The return from the browser contains no Deye passwords or tokens.
deye.selected: Connected · station selected. Waiting for the first sync.
ha.body: Add home context without sending device commands. Select only the entities you want to see.
ha.consent: Allow connecting and processing the entities I select.
ha.instructions: Enter the code in your local Home Assistant bridge. The connection starts from your home; no port forwarding is needed.
